definition: The master weighting rule. Benefics improve what they touch (bonification); malefics harm what they touch (maltreatment). This decides whether a given meaning resolves well or badly.

bonification.effect: A planet or point a benefic conjoins or aspects (especially by trine or sextile, in tight orb) is helped, protected, and its outcomes improved.
bonification.strength: The in-sect benefic (Jupiter by day, Venus by night) bonifies most strongly.

maltreatment.effect: A planet or point a malefic conjoins, squares, or opposes (in tight orb) is harmed and its outcomes worsened.
maltreatment.strength: The out-of-sect malefic (Saturn by night, Mars by day) maltreats most harshly; a dignified or in-sect malefic does far less damage.

overcoming: The planet in the earlier zodiacal degree holds the superior position and dominates the relationship, especially across a square.
appUsage: After reading a transit, scan for a benefic or malefic also aspecting the same point. Benefic present -> weight the outcome UP. Malefic present -> weight it DOWN, more so if out of sect. This converts a neutral meaning into a good or bad day.
summary: Benefic and malefic contacts weight whether an indication resolves more easily or more harshly.
body: The master weighting rule. Benefics improve what they touch (bonification); malefics harm what they touch (maltreatment). This decides whether a given meaning resolves well or badly.
